text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 黑色修身翻领长袖衬衫，卡其色双排扣高腰短裙，黑色漆皮尖头高跟鞋，裙上可拆宽腰带单独出图。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue image, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, realistic fabric/construction. Portrait 2:3; entire objects fully visible with comfortable margins. No text, watermark, people, skin, body parts, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, support or scene. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation, no skin-colored filling in stockings. Preserve exact visible color, silhouette, pattern and details. Conservatively reconstruct occluded details without adding decoration. The ONLY target is the 整图 outfit in the reference (Chinese position; 上排左=top left, 上排中=top center, 上排右=top right, 下排左=bottom left, 下排中=bottom center, 下排右=bottom right, 左=left, 右=right, 整图=single outfit). Ignore every other panel. GARMENTS AND FOOTWEAR ONLY: 黑色修身翻领长袖衬衫，卡其色双排扣高腰短裙，黑色漆皮尖头高跟鞋，裙上腰带已取下，仅留空腰带环. Remove ALL detachable accessories, including 卡其色宽方扣腰带；棕色小肩包；银色流苏链条小包；银色细吊坠项链. Keep integral garment buttons, fasteners and sewn ties. Do not add any other item. CRITICAL CORRECTION: No belt anywhere in the image. Show exactly the black shirt, khaki double-breasted mini skirt with EMPTY belt loops, and pair of black pumps. Remove the detached horizontal belt completely; do not display it beside the outfit.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
